biggest_catch: Business-only — you need a business identified by a Tax ID (EIN) to qualify; it is NOT a personal checking bonus. Sole proprietors should confirm eligibility with FNBO (the offer terms identify customers by business + Tax ID). Available only in FNBO's footprint (CO, IA, IL, KS, NE, SD, TX, WY).
catches: BUSINESS accounts only — the bonus is identified by business + Tax ID (EIN); not available for personal use. Sole proprietors should confirm eligibility with FNBO.
Available only online and at FNBO-branded branches in counties served by FNBO (CO, IA, IL, KS, NE, SD, TX, WY footprint).
New Free Business Checking customers only: cannot have an open Free Business Checking, Premium Checking, or Analyzed Checking account at account opening.
Must provide promo code 250BIZ at account opening (online or in branch).
Within 31 calendar days of account opening: receive qualifying deposit(s) totaling at least $1,000 OR complete 10+ qualifying debit card purchases that post and clear.
Account must be opened on or before 12/31/2026.
Limit one bonus per customer (identified by business and Tax ID); one per qualifying account for joint accounts.
